dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pigmented structures exhibit sharp gradient transitions from a dark-brown exterior to a cream-colored interior. The perimeters are irregular and non-uniform, with the most distinct annulus in the mid-anterior section showing an elongated, closed-loop geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of high-intensity cream-colored pixel clusters is localized across the mid-dorsal and lateral-midline regions. These clusters are concentrated into both isolated asymmetrical blobs and as components within larger annular networks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annular structures form an obtuse scalene triangle across the mid-lateral field. A series of smaller high-intensity blobs form a semi-linear chain approximately parallel to the horizontal axis of the seal's body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, localized areas of reddish-pink pigmentation, suggestive of epithelial tissue exposure or lesions, are visible on the posterior flipper surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, dark, elongated keratinized structures (claws) are visible on the anterior flipper; micro-scale mottled flecking is present between the major macro-annuli patterns.
